invocation.stdin: JSON array of public case records
invocation.execution_owner: native coding agent or explicit human command in a separate demo worktree

allowed_human_change.admission: explicit human acceptance of the current semantic requirement; no automatic fixture admission

rules: Accept records with unique nonempty printable ASCII SKU of at most 64 characters, integer qty from 0 through 1000000000, and valid supported RFC3339 timestamp.
Compute age from parsed instants, never lexical timestamp comparison.
Keep rows if 0 <= reference_time - updatedAt <= max_age_seconds * 1000.
Order by ASCII SKU comparison; emit header sku,qty,updated_at_utc and LF-terminated rows.
Normalize timestamps to ISO UTC with millisecond precision.
CSV uses comma delimiters; quote fields containing comma or quote and double embedded quotes.
Reject invalid record/duplicate/timestamp with exit 2, empty stdout and stable error code; never silently skip invalid records.

authored_seed.required_observable_defect: preserves timestamp text rather than normalized UTC; the public mixed-offset case exposes this deliberately authored defect
authored_seed.disclosure: authored deliberately imperfect starting implementation; not a forced mistake by the model

incompatible_procedure_case.reason: different output contract; inventory-export-v1 procedure must not auto-apply

requirement_change_note: A generic implementation may support the changed threshold unchanged. Check the observed output under the current requirement; do not force a code change or invent a failure.

compatible_reuse.disclosure: publicly authored compatible reuse example; not sealed, statistically independent or previously observed agent behavior

evaluation.owner: human or separate temporary verification script
evaluation.assertions: compare observed stdout, exit status and diagnostic code with the public case data
evaluation.evidence: record actual observed outcomes as sources; expected outputs are a specification, never evidence of an executed check
evaluation.scope: demo evaluation only; Threadline does not execute code, own a checker or certify protected completion

goal: Produce deterministic CSV for valid fresh inventory rows, sorted by SKU, with UTC timestamps and correctly escaped fields. Reject invalid input without partial output.
